hero.heading: Walk into every visit already briefed.
hero.subheading: Acute Insight AI gathers, structures, and summarizes your patients' histories before the visit — adaptive AI intake for them, a flagged clinical brief for you. Now enrolling early-access practices in our clinical beta.

benefits.heading: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

items.title: AI-prepared patient briefs
items.body: Every patient arrives with a structured clinical summary generated from their adaptive intake. You know the chief complaint, severity, duration, medications, allergies, and relevant history before you open the chart.

items.title: Clinical flags up front
items.body: High severity ratings, red-flag symptoms, and chronic patterns are extracted automatically and surfaced at the top of each brief — a deterministic safety layer plus AI review on every intake.

items.title: Emergency screening built in
items.body: Patients describing emergency-level symptoms are immediately directed to 911/ER guidance during intake — before the case ever sits in your queue.

items.title: Works in any browser
items.body: The provider dashboard is web-based with nothing to install and no EHR integration required to start. Review briefs from the clinic, the hospital, or home.

items.title: Built by a practicing hospitalist
items.body: Acute Insight AI is physician-founded. The intake protocol, the flags, and the brief format are designed around how clinicians actually think — and refined in real clinical work.

items.title: Free during the beta
items.body: Early-access practices use Acute Insight AI at no cost during the clinical beta, and get a direct line to the founder to shape what gets built next.

howItWorks.heading: From request to first brief in days

steps.title: Request early access
steps.body: Tell us about your practice. We'll set up your provider account and walk you through the dashboard — setup takes minutes, not weeks.

steps.title: Patients complete their intake
steps.body: Invite patients to complete their intake before the visit — from any device, at their own pace, with emergency screening built in.

steps.title: Review AI-prepared briefs
steps.body: Each completed intake lands in your queue as a structured brief: chief complaint, HPI, medications, allergies, history, and clinical flags. Search and filter to what needs attention.

steps.title: Walk in prepared
steps.body: Start the visit at the real conversation. Your patients stop repeating themselves, and you stop excavating the story from scratch.

earnings.heading: Built with early practices, not just for them
earnings.body: We're enrolling a small group of practices and independent clinicians to use Acute Insight AI in real workflows and shape its roadmap. Beta participants pay nothing and get direct access to the founding team.
